body:
This all started about 18 months ago when a friend of mine introduced me to a little orange pill called oxycontin. At first we would just swallow the wonderful little pill which gave us a pleasantly warm sensation and a moderate painkilling effect, but one day we decided to experiment with it, so we crushed up the pill and sniffed it.
We were shocked, the effects of sniffing oxycontin are way more intense than swallowing it. Within 2 minutes it started working, it was like a rush of energy, happiness, and well being all in one; not to mention the huge painkilling effects. One of the best things about this drug is that you have so much self-confidence and you don't give a fuck about anyone or anything. This drug can also be very dangerous. Since oxycontin is supposed to be a 12-hour release pill, when sniffed it can dangerously lower your respiratory system, which could lead to respiratory failure if you were to overdose on it.
If it's your first time I wouldn't start with any more than 20mg and then work your way up slowly. Oxycontin is also very addicting and if abused too much it can lead to a very painful addiction, and not to mention the withdrawals of oxycontin are very similar to those of heroin. So remember oxycontin is a very powerful drug, be careful and respect it.
